aditya_archive_structural_checks.interpretation: Structural sample consistency only. MJD was compared using an assumed UTC scale; authority, FITS time reference, GTI closure and application remain UNVERIFIED without the registered instrument manuals.

event_reconciliation.class_policy: candidate matching is timestamp-only; exact normalized classes and family agreement are reported separately; no class is overwritten
event_reconciliation.negative_label_reason: NOAA documentation defines a science-quality composite event report and one entry per reported flare, but does not establish a completeness guarantee for all possible events/measurement gaps in this interval.
event_reconciliation.time_match_policy: candidate if absolute start-time difference <= 60 seconds; tolerance reflects official 1-minute report resolution

goes_measurement_quality.csv_comparison_rule: exact timestamp join; pairwise relative tolerance 1e-7 for NetCDF float32/CSV decimal representation; fill values never replaced

instrument_semantics.hel1os: UNVERIFIED; MJD/ISOT structurally inspectable but authoritative time field/scale and quality/GTI rules undocumented
instrument_semantics.solexs: UNVERIFIED; GTI numeric endpoints observed but units/closure/reference undocumented

readiness.chronological_split_safeguards: Existing causal trailing rolling features, chronological partitions, horizon-tail purging, train-only scaler fitting and no shuffling were inspected and preserved; no boundaries selected.
readiness.distinct_event_threshold_proposal: For a future exploratory split only, first test the repository's existing >=5 distinct M/X events per partition as a floor; it is not a universal adequacy claim. A defensible evaluation needs a predeclared larger event-powered rationale and longer coverage.
